messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed the latency dashboard legend is showing p95/p99 but the sample source column is blank for many endpoints. dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/latency

David: Which dashboard? can you paste the endpoint

maya: /v1/generate - top right legend shows 'p50 p95 p99' but hovering shows 'sample_source: -' for several rows

chen: hmm that's likely the merge from rollup tiles — we dropped sample_source during the aggregation. it still stores tags but legend component isn't reading them

olivia: is this why the per-route SLOs looked different yesterday? I saw p95 jump but sample counts were tiny

maya: yeah, p95 jump only had 12 samples; dashboard treated it as representative which misled PMs

jihoon: tl;dr: two problems: a) legend/dropdown doesn't annotate which percentile is from which sample set b) we show percentiles without min sample count warning

chen: agree. proposal: show a small "sample_src" badge per legend item (edge/proxy/router) and gray out percentiles with count < 50 and show tooltip "low sample". Also surface raw sample_count in tooltip

david: can we compute sample_count per-quantile? our t-digest rollups lose per-quantile counts

chen: we have sample_count per-bucket window before compressing. we can expose that alongside the tdigest as metadata. not trivial but doable

maya: UX: also add a toggle "only show percentiles with >= N samples" default 30

olivia: pls add a quick note in rollout docs so SEs don't misinterpret during canaries

sre-bot: new ticket created: PLAT-4921 "latency legend: sample_source + low-sample handling" assigned to @chen

chen: I'll prototype a small patch — likely add sample_source to legend renderer + tooltip. pinging @david for backend API

david: I can add the /api/v1/metrics/rollup?include_meta=1 flag. will start tomorrow

jihoon: timeframe? needs to be before next canary on Tue

chen: aiming EOD Mon for frontend PR, backend branch by tomorrow

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: backend branch -> staging @ 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC

maya: thanks. once in staging, please post a screenshot of updated legend here

olivia: also add automated test for sample_count badge

maya: :thumbsup: great, thanks all
